The matter relates to C.P. Case No.64 of 2016, pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Dhanbad.
2.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners on instruction submits that now the husband and wife are residing together and the matter is arising out of Section 498A and other Sections of the IPC.

3. Learned counsel for the State submits that if the matter is compromised and they reside together,
the matter may be disposed of with liberty to move before the learned Court.

4. In view of such submission, this petition is being disposed of with liberty to the petitioner if there is any compromise, they may pursue the same before the learned Court where the matter is pending.
